_comment: Draw a card. 'Costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control' is a play-cost DISCOUNT, not a cost to pay; the prior JSON modeled it as an additional PAY_LIFE of the Runechant count, which is wrong (it would drain life). The dynamic self-discount isn't cleanly modeled, so it is omitted (card plays at full cost); the draw is the only real effect.
